patients.summary: Automotive mechanic with Wilson disease, compensated cirrhosis and type 2 diabetes who joins in 2020; hereditary hemochromatosis is found in 2022 and membranous nephropathy in 2023, followed by a run of serious infections and an amoxicillin hemolysis, with slow decline to CKD 3a. Records from outside care are sparse; a 2026 GI bleed admission arrives after his last visit.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT VISIT

43M, mechanic at an auto repair shop, here to set up primary care. His last PCP closed her practice over the summer and he went months without anyone. Wife made the appointment.

Main issues he brings:
1. Wilson disease. Diagnosed 2017 after his liver tests came back off and he had some slurring of speech and a hand tremor. Sees an outside hepatology group; on trientine 250 mg twice a day and keeps copper low in the diet (no shellfish, nuts, chocolate, liver). Says the speech and tremor settled after treatment started. Gets 24 h urine copper checks through them.
2. Cirrhosis. Hepatology told him his liver is scarred, from the Wilson disease and years of drinking. No known bleeding, no fluid, never been yellow. They follow it.
3. Type 2 diabetes. On metformin 1000 mg twice daily, tolerates it. No home meter readings to share; says his A1c was fine last time.
4. Alcohol. Drank heavily for years; stopped in February of this year on his own and has not had a drink since. Knows he can't go back to it with his liver. Not in a program, says he doesn't need one right now. Open to talking more if that changes.
5. Weight. Has been heavy for a long time.

Tobacco: smoked for years, quit 2016. No vaping. No drugs.
Family: brother has Wilson disease too and got cirrhosis young. Father with type 2 diabetes. Mother with an underactive thyroid.
Allergies: none known.
Meds: metformin 1000 mg BID, trientine 250 mg BID.

ROS: no abdominal swelling, no black stools, no vomiting blood, no confusion, no leg swelling. Energy ok. Works full days on his feet.

Exam: obese man in no distress. No scleral icterus. Mouth and throat normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen obese, soft, nontender, no shifting dullness. No edema. Speech normal, no tremor at rest or with arms out. Skin without spider angiomas.

PHQ-2 0. AUDIT-C 0 (abstinent).

A/P
- Wilson disease / cirrhosis, compensated: continue trientine; hepatology owns this, will request their notes. CMP, CBC today.
- T2DM: A1c, UACR, lipids today. Continue metformin. Eye exam this year.
- AUD in remission: congratulated him; door open.
- Prevention: HCV, HIV once. Check hep B immunity given cirrhosis. Flu shot and pneumococcal vaccine next visit with nurse.
- Return 3 months, sooner by text if needed.

documents.title: Records request
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Records request faxed to hepatology group and prior PCP office per signed release.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hi Adam, your labs are back. Your diabetes number (A1c) is in a good range. Your liver tests are a little above normal, which fits with what hepatology already knows, and your platelet count is on the low side of normal, also typical with a scarred liver. Kidneys look fine, no protein in the urine. Hepatitis C and HIV screens are negative.

One thing: you are not immune to hepatitis B. With your liver, I'd like you protected. It's a two-shot series a month apart. Can we start it with your flu shot? The front desk will set up a nurse visit.

documents.title: RE: Your lab results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: ok thanks. tuesdays are best, shop is slow

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In for flu, PPSV23 and hep B #1 per PCP orders. Screening questions negative, no prior reactions. Flu IM L deltoid, PPSV23 IM R deltoid, Heplisav-B IM L deltoid lower site. VIS sheets given. Tolerated well. Hep B #2 due in about 4 weeks, scheduled for 11/10.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Hep B #2
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Heplisav-B dose 2 of 2 given IM R deltoid. Sore arm for a day after the first one, nothing else. Series complete.

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Telehealth Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video visit from his truck on lunch break, identity verified, consents to video.

Diabetes check-in. Labs from yesterday: A1c steady in the high 6s, liver numbers unchanged from September. Taking metformin twice a day without trouble. Still not drinking, about 10 months now. Hepatology saw him in the fall and kept trientine the same.

No new symptoms.

A/P: T2DM at goal on metformin. Wilson/cirrhosis stable per hepatology. Will ask again for their records (first request unanswered). Office visit in ~6 months with labs.

documents.title: Records request, second
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Second request faxed to hepatology. Prior PCP office sent immunization list only (flu shots, nothing else on file).

documents.title: Prior authorization - trientine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Specialty pharmacy called: insurer wants prior auth renewal on trientine for 2021. Prescriber of record is hepatology, not us. Gave pharmacy the hepatology office fax. Called pt to let him know so he doesn't run out; he has about 2 weeks left and will call hepatology too.

documents.title: Prior authorization - trientine (follow-up)
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pt called back, hepatology got the PA approved, capsules shipping this week. Nothing needed from us.

documents.title: Outside immunization - COVID-19 dose 2

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Routine check. Down a couple pounds, cut out soda at work. Sugars fine when he checks, which is rarely. Abstinent, 16 months. Trientine twice daily, sometimes forgets the evening dose when he works late; we talked about pairing it with something he does every night. Had both COVID shots in the spring. No abdominal swelling, no dark stools, no yellowing.

O: Vitals reviewed. Alert, normal speech. No icterus. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no ascites. No edema. Feet: skin intact, monofilament sensation normal both feet, DP pulses 2+.

A/P
- T2DM, at goal: same metformin. A1c, UACR today.
- Cirrhosis / Wilson: CMP, CBC today; hepatology records still not here, third request sent. Pt says his last copper check was fine.
- Eye exam: he'll book with the optometrist near the shop.
- Physical in the fall with flu shot.

documents.title: Result note
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c at goal. Liver tests and platelets stable. UACR normal. Pt messaged.

documents.title: Diabetic Eye Examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Re: Adam Coughlin, DOB 02/21/1977
Exam date 08/17/2021. Dilated fundus exam OU. Visual acuity 20/20 OD, 20/25 OS uncorrected. No diabetic retinopathy either eye. No macular edema. Lens clear. Recommend repeat dilated exam in 12 months.
Optometry

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL

44M. Doing well. Working full time, lots of overtime this summer. No drinking since Feb 2020. Former smoker, quit 2016. Wife wants him to walk more; he does some weekends.

Interval: eye exam in August, no retinopathy. Hepatology visit in the spring, no changes, trientine 250 BID.

ROS negative.

Exam: obese. HEENT normal. Neck supple, no thyromegaly. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, no ascites, nontender. Skin: no jaundice, no rashes. Joints: full ROM hands, knees. Neuro: no tremor, gait normal. Feet normal.

Screens: PHQ-2 0, AUDIT-C 0.

A/P
- Health maintenance: flu and Tdap today (last tetanus he can't remember, works with sharp metal). Colorectal screening starts at 45, next year. Lipids, CMP, CBC, A1c today.
- T2DM: continue metformin.
- Wilson/cirrhosis: per hepatology.
- Follow-up 4 months.

documents.title: Result note
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Lipids acceptable. CMP, CBC as before. A1c at goal.
